name: BA-6A
description: Tube compressor and limiting amplifier based on a 1950s design.

implementations.notes: Gazelle reports this type ID in model-local read-only enumeration on 2026-09-13. Control names are declared, not byte encodings or verified writes. This is reference metadata, not a contract for the local stub profile.
UNVERIFIED: confirm the effect type and each control on Orion before assigning a type ID, command, or encoding.

parameters.read_layout: per instance: one flag byte, the block the write frame carries, then padding up to read_stride (measured with this project's own cat 0x07 read; instance 0 held the block the vendor panel last wrote)
parameters.notes: BA-6A. Each listed control was wheeled to both ends in the vendor panel and moved only its own bytes; min/max are the raw limits seen. Raw units: no physical unit is claimed. Bytes of the block not listed here (switches, menus, stacked rings the wheel did not reach) are unmapped and are written back unchanged.
